name: Colorado Mountain Home
address: 10915 Iona Ave, Green Mountain Falls, CO 80819
short_description: Spacious family home with panoramic valley views, Dance-Dance machine, and shuffleboard table.
full_description:
The village of Green Mountain Falls is one of Colorado's premier family vacation spots. Trout fishing, mountain climbing, hiking, shopping or dining, swimming, horseback riding or just relaxing with the wild life is the essence of a great family vacation. The hospitality of this village is second to none.

Our cabin, located at 10915 Iona, has been in our family for many years – mostly used as a 2nd home – a summer get-a-way. It has a panoramic view; yet it is snuggled in the mountains for that true mountain feel. The view from the living room, outside deck and back yard encompasses the entire valley below. Wildlife is abundant and several hiking trails are close to the house.

For entertainment, there is a dance-dance machine…just like the ones you have seen in the mall; a shuffleboard game table, and various games, movies, puzzles and books. You will enjoy a small fishing lake with a gazebo located right in the middle of the downtown area, among the shops, great restaurants and cafes. It is close to Woodland Park, Colorado Springs, and Pikes Peak. There are a multitude of activities all around the Green Mountain Falls area. The town is known for the beautiful Falls – which is a short hike to the first set of Falls, or you can do a longer hike to the second set of Falls. There is a lovely public outdoor swimming pool and tennis courts just around the corner from the small lake located in the center of the village.

This cabin is ideally suited for family reunions, scrapbooking, birthday parties, business retreats, weddings, wedding anniversaries, honeymoons, Air Force graduations, or any other special occasion. You can enjoy the cooler climate at an elevation of 8,700 ft. surrounded by aspens, pines and interesting wildlife. You will be just minutes away from all of the Pikes Peak region attractions such as Garden of the Gods, Cave of the Winds, Manitou Cliff Dwellings, Pikes Peak Cog Railway, Seven Falls, and the famous Flying W Ranch. The Royal Gorge and river rafting are only an hour drive and the historic mining town of Cripple Creek is only 35 miles away. There are bountiful activities such as hiking, biking, fishing, horseback riding, antique shopping, museums, and fine arts. We know you will enjoy your visit to this beautiful mountain village.
